stories.title: Russia launches one of its biggest strikes of the war, killing at least 20 civilians across Ukraine
stories.reason: Roughly 70 missiles and 130 drones hit at least 12 regions including Kyiv, Poltava and Kharkiv, with a strike on a Pryluky apartment block killing five alone, as Zelensky said Ukraine's Patriot interceptor shortage left it unable to fully blunt the attack.

stories.title: Samsung Electronics posts a record $80 billion quarterly profit, up nearly 800% on AI memory demand
stories.reason: Preliminary Q3 operating profit of 107.4 trillion won beat the previous quarter's record by 20%, driven by surging HBM and DRAM prices, even as the mobile division is expected to post a loss on the same rising memory costs.

stories.title: Houthi attacks kill three and injure 36 at Saudi Arabia's Riyadh and Abha airports
stories.reason: Saudi aviation authorities said missile and drone strikes hit King Khalid International and Abha airports on consecutive days, killing a Sudanese, a Moroccan and an Algerian national, as Houthi forces framed the attacks as retaliation for Saudi-backed strikes inside Yemen.

stories.title: Most US voters say Trump and Congress aren't taking AI risks seriously, Reuters/Ipsos poll finds
stories.reason: Some 57% of registered voters, including a third of Republicans, fault the administration's approach, while 84% see AI as a threat to American jobs and bipartisan majorities back stricter regulation, putting the issue squarely into next month's midterm campaign.

stories.title: Rubio ties 'America First' to ancient Greek values in a sweeping Athens speech
stories.reason: Speaking atop the Pnyx, Rubio traced a lineage from Athens through Rome to the US founding and called for America to dominate drones, critical minerals, cybersecurity and AI, in a speech widely read as positioning him for a future presidential run.

stories.title: Lambda seeks up to $4 billion in its final private round before a planned 2027 IPO
stories.reason: The Nvidia-backed cloud provider, led by Blackstone and Coatue at a $14.5 billion valuation, has seen its order backlog triple to $50 billion since June, largely on the strength of a $35 billion compute commitment from Anthropic signed in August.

stories.title: Marvell sets a $70-90 billion revenue target for 2031, far above Wall Street's expectations
stories.reason: The chipmaker's first-ever guidance that far out implies annual growth of 54-61% from an $8.2 billion base, well above analysts' $47 billion consensus, betting on data-center capital spending it projects will hit $3 trillion by 2030.

stories.title: Amazon cuts about 1,000 corporate jobs, mostly in its Stores division
stories.reason: The cuts hit customer service, marketplace support and engineering roles across the US, UK and India during Prime Big Deal Days, the latest in a string of reductions since a 30,000-job restructuring that began last year.
